translations.web: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
translations.bsb: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.
translations.kjv: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
